name: @exvlan/browser
description: Run an Exvlan TCP client in the browser

scripts.build:wasm: node ../runtime/scripts/build-wasm.mjs browser src/generated/exvlan_core.wasm && node ../runtime/scripts/validate-wasm.mjs browser src/generated/exvlan_core.wasm
scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:dependencies && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --loader:.wasm=binary --external:@exvlan/runtime --external:@exvlan/runtime/* --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.build:demo: pnpm build:dependencies && esbuild demo/smoke.ts --bundle --format=esm --loader:.wasm=binary --outfile=demo/smoke.js && node ../runtime/scripts/copy-artifact.mjs src/generated/exvlan_core.wasm demo/generated/exvlan_core.wasm
scripts.smoke:node: pnpm build:demo && esbuild demo/node-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=demo/generated/node-smoke.js && node demo/generated/node-smoke.js
